addDescription: Drop audio files here or choose files. Add one to trim, or several to merge.
formatsNote: MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG, FLAC, and WebM, where supported by your browser.
privacyNote: Files stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
clipsDescription: Keep the highlighted region of each clip. Clips merge in the order shown.
emptyDescription: Add a recording, song, or voice note to select the part you want to keep.
exportDescription: Export one trimmed clip or join all selected regions into a single file.
smoothDescription: Apply a short 10 ms fade at each edge to reduce clicks at cuts.
outputNote: 48 kHz. Mono stays mono; mixed mono and stereo clips export as stereo.
readError: Could not read “{name}”. Try a supported audio file such as MP3 or WAV.
exportError: Could not create the audio file. Try another output format, shorter clips, or fewer files.
unsupportedError: This browser cannot decode audio. Try a current version of Chrome, Firefox, or Safari.
rangeError: Enter a start time before the end time, within the clip duration.
channelError: “{name}” has more than two channels. Use a mono or stereo audio file.
playError: Could not play the selection. Try again or create the audio file to preview it.
formatM4aNote: AAC in an M4A file: compact and widely playable.
formatWebmNote: Opus in a WebM file: efficient for voice and music. Check that your destination supports WebM.
nativeFormatsNote: AAC and Opus use your browser’s encoder. Unavailable formats are disabled.
formatUnavailable: This browser cannot encode this format with the current settings. Choose another format or quality.
formatMp3Note: MP3: compact and widely compatible. Good for sharing recordings and music.
formatWavNote: WAV: uncompressed 16-bit PCM. Larger files, with no additional lossy compression.
formatOggNote: OGG Vorbis: compact, open-format audio. Check that your destination supports OGG.
oggQualityNote: Variable bitrate. Actual size depends on the audio.
duplicateDescription: Duplicate a clip to keep another section of the same recording.
joinNote: Crossfades overlap clips and shorten the result. Each overlap is limited to half the length of either adjacent clip.
joinError: Enter a transition duration from 0 to 5 seconds.
